inputs.commit_message: chore: establish ASOL completion branch and baseline
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/hesham/gova
branch=fix-asol-control-complete
wt=/tmp/gova-fix-asol-control-complete-baseline
git -C "$repo" fetch --prune origin main
if ! git -C "$repo" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$branch" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git -C "$repo" push origin origin/main:refs/heads/$branch
fi
git -C "$repo" fetch origin "$branch"
git -C "$repo" worktree remove --force "$wt" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -rf "$wt"
git -C "$repo" worktree prune
git -C "$repo" worktree add --detach "$wt" "origin/$branch"
cd "$wt"
echo ASOL_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo MAIN_HEAD=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
echo '--- PLAN ARTIFACTS ---'
test -f note/asol-control-single-agent-execution-plan.md && echo PLAN=present || echo PLAN=missing
test -d services/control && echo CONTROL_SERVICE=present || echo CONTROL_SERVICE=missing
test -d packages/control-composition && echo CONTROL_COMPOSITION=present || echo CONTROL_COMPOSITION=missing
echo '--- AGENT TOOLS ---'
(command -v codex && codex --version) || true
(command -v claude && claude --version) || true
echo '--- GATES ---'
run_gate(){ name="$1"; shift; echo "== $name =="; set +e; "$@"; rc=$?; set -e; echo "GATE:$name:$rc"; }
run_gate architecture npm run architecture:check
run_gate typecheck npm run typecheck
run_gate lint npm run lint
run_gate control_verify npm run control:verify
run_gate control_build npm run control:build
run_gate control_smoke npm run control:smoke
run_gate github_policy npm run github:ci-policy
echo '--- STATUS ---'
git status --short
echo ASOL_BASELINE_SCAN=DONE
